# Written by Stackly from the official/traefik provider; edits are replaced.
global:
  checkNewVersion: false
  sendAnonymousUsage: false
log:
  level: "ERROR"
entryPoints:
  web:
    address: "127.0.0.1:14001"
  ping:
    address: "127.0.0.1:14000"
ping:
  entryPoint: ping
api:
  dashboard: false
  insecure: false
providers:
  file:
    directory: "/Volumes/Test Root/Ünï cödé/data/instances/0192f000-0000-7000-8000-00000000000a/config/dynamic"
    watch: true

# Written by Stackly from the routes setting; edits are replaced.
http:
  routers:
    "api":
      rule: "Host(`api.localhost`)"
      service: "api"
      entryPoints:
        - web
    "web-app":
      rule: "Host(`app.localhost`) && PathPrefix(`/v1`)"
      service: "web-app"
      entryPoints:
        - web
    "docs":
      rule: "Host(\"docs.localhost\") || PathPrefix(`/docs`)"
      service: "docs"
      entryPoints:
        - web
  services:
    "api":
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://127.0.0.1:3000"
    "web-app":
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://localhost:5173/"
    "docs":
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://[::1]:8080/docs"
